import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text, split_graphemes, _split_text

    """Test that splitting at column zero returns empty left and full text right."""
    text = "Hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "Hello"

import pytest
from rich.segment import Segment
from rich.style import Style


def test_segment_split_cells_at_zero():
    """Test that Segment.split_cells at column zero returns empty left segment and full right segment."""
    segment = Segment("Hello", Style(bold=True))
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert right.text == "Hello"
    assert left.style == segment.style
    assert right.style == segment.style


def test_segment_split_cells_at_zero_no_style():
    """Test Segment.split_cells at zero without style."""
    segment = Segment("World")
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert right.text == "World"
    assert left.style is None
    assert right.style is None


def test_segment_split_cells_at_zero_with_control():
    """Test Segment.split_cells at zero with control code."""
    control_code = (1,)  # ControlType.BELL
    segment = Segment("Test", None, (control_code,))
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert right.text == "Test"
    assert left.control == segment.control
    assert right.control == segment.control


def test_segment_split_cells_middle():
    """Test that split_cells in the middle still works (regression test)."""
    segment = Segment("Hello")
    left, right = segment.split_cells(2)
    assert left.text == "He"
    assert right.text == "llo"


def test_segment_split_cells_at_length():
    """Test that split_cells at text length still works (regression test)."""
    segment = Segment("Hello")
    left, right = segment.split_cells(5)
    assert left.text == "Hello"
    assert right.text == ""

import pytest
from rich.cells import split_graphemes


def test_split_graphemes_simple():
    """Test basic grapheme splitting."""
    text = "Hello"
    spans, total_width = split_graphemes(text)
    assert len(spans) == 5
    assert total_width == 5
    # Each span should be (start, end, width)
    assert spans[0] == (0, 1, 1)
    assert spans[4] == (4, 5, 1)


def test_split_graphemes_empty():
    """Test splitting empty string."""
    text = ""
    spans, total_width = split_graphemes(text)
    assert len(spans) == 0
    assert total_width == 0


def test_split_graphemes_double_width():
    """Test grapheme splitting with double-width characters."""
    text = "a中"  # 'a' is 1 cell, '中' is 2 cells
    spans, total_width = split_graphemes(text)
    assert len(spans) == 2
    assert total_width == 3
    assert spans[0][2] == 1  # 'a' has cell width 1
    assert spans[1][2] == 2  # '中' has cell width 2


def test_split_graphemes_preserves_indices():
    """Test that grapheme splits preserve character indices."""
    text = "Hi中"
    spans, _ = split_graphemes(text)
    # Spans should cover the entire string with no gaps
    for i, (start, end, _) in enumerate(spans):
        if i > 0:
            assert spans[i-1][1] == start  # Previous end matches current start

import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text


def test_split_text_various_positions():
    """Test split_text at various positions."""
    text = "Test"
    
    # Position 0
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert (left, right) == ("", "Test")
    
    # Position 1
    left, right = split_text(text, 1)
    assert (left, right) == ("T", "est")
    
    # Position 4 (end)
    left, right = split_text(text, 4)
    assert (left, right) == ("Test", "")
    
    # Past end
    left, right = split_text(text, 10)
    assert (left, right) == ("Test", "")


def test_split_text_single_cell_optimization():
    """Test that single-cell-width text takes fast path."""
    # This text contains only ASCII characters (single cell each)
    text = "Simple"
    left, right = split_text(text, 3)
    assert left == "Sim"
    assert right == "ple"


def test_split_text_all_positions_single_cell():
    """Test splitting at all positions in single-cell text."""
    text = "ABC"
    for pos in range(0, len(text) + 2):
        left, right = split_text(text, pos)
        assert left + right == text
        assert len(left) == min(pos, len(text))

import pytest
from rich.segment import Segment
from rich.style import Style


def test_segment_split_cells_various_widths():
    """Test split_cells with various text widths."""
    segment = Segment("Test")
    
    # Test at various positions
    positions = [0, 1, 2, 4, 10]
    for pos in positions:
        left, right = segment.split_cells(pos)
        # Left text length should be <= pos, right text should complete the string
        assert len(left.text) + len(right.text) >= len(segment.text) or pos > len(segment.text)


def test_segment_split_cells_preserves_style():
    """Test that split_cells preserves style in both segments."""
    style = Style(bold=True, italic=True)
    segment = Segment("Hello", style)
    
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.style == style
    assert right.style == style
    
    left, right = segment.split_cells(2)
    assert left.style == style
    assert right.style == style


def test_segment_split_cells_empty_text():
    """Test split_cells on empty segment."""
    segment = Segment("")
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert right.text == ""
